description: Find facilities in Japan near a named train or subway station — convenience stores (konbini: 7-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart), restaurants, pharmacies, hospitals, ATMs, banks, hotels, supermarkets near a Shinkansen, JR, subway or private-railway station. Answers "convenience stores within 500m of Shibuya station", "pharmacies near Shinjuku station", "hospitals near Namba station". Geocodes the station name within Japan, then searches OpenStreetMap around it. Returns each place's name, category, distance in metres and coordinates.

category.description: What to find: "convenience_store", "station" (another station nearby), "hospital", "pharmacy", "restaurant", "cafe", "supermarket", "bank", "atm", "hotel", "post_office", "toilet", "parking", "temple", "shrine", "park" — or an exact OSM tag like "shop=bakery".

station.description: Station or place name, e.g. "Shibuya Station", "Shinjuku Station, Tokyo", "Namba Station, Osaka". Adding the city helps disambiguate common names.

name: places_near_station
